mail_invite_startup.subject: yo
mail_invite_startup.body: yo {player_name} loved ur profile. can u do a video call today or tmrw?? - {company} (founder is busy, this is Dana)

mail_invite_mid.subject: Interview: {job_title}
mail_invite_mid.body: Hi {player_name}! We'd love to chat. One conversation with Dana from People, today or tomorrow. A real human. We know. Rare.

mail_invite_big.subject: Next steps: Stage 1 of 7
mail_invite_big.body: Congratulations! You've reached Stage 1 of 7 for {job_title}. Please attend an in-person interview today or tomorrow. Parking is not validated.

mail_invite_radar.subject: A human actually read it!
mail_invite_radar.body: Hi {player_name}, a recruiter at {company} read your CV. On purpose. Interview today or tomorrow?

mail_invite_guarantee.subject: Saw your profile!
mail_invite_guarantee.body: Hi {player_name}! {company} saw your application. Fast. Suspiciously fast. Interview today or tomorrow?

mail_invite_grace.subject: Landlord
mail_invite_grace.body: Your landlord gave you one more day. ONE. Make this interview count.

mail_invite_expired.subject: Update
mail_invite_expired.body: The role was filled internally. It always was.

mail_knockout.subject: Update on your application
mail_knockout.body: Hi {player_name}, after careful consideration (0.4 seconds, at 3:07 AM), we won't be moving forward. Knockout: {knockout}. - Parsinator 3000

mail_reject_01: After careful consideration, we've decided to move forward with other candidates.
mail_reject_02: Dear [FIRST_NAME], we regret to inform you about [JOB_TITLE]. Warmly, [RECRUITER].
mail_reject_03: You're overqualified for this entry-level role and underqualified for its salary.
mail_reject_04: The role went to an internal candidate. It always was. We had to post it anyway.
mail_reject_05: We loved you! We chose someone equally lovable with 7 more years of experience.
mail_reject_06: Our AI screener made a decision. It declined to explain. It declined us too.
mail_reject_07: Due to shifting priorities, this role no longer exists. Neither does the team.
mail_reject_08: We'll keep your CV on file. The file is very large. It is also a shredder.
mail_reject_09: Thanks for applying! This is an automated message. So was the decision.
mail_reject_10: Great news: you made the top 3,000! Bad news: we're hiring one.
notif_profile_view: HumbleBrag: a recruiter viewed your profile! See who with Premium Gold+. (It was a bot.)
offer_role: We are thrilled (legally required wording) to offer you the role of {job_title}.
offer_commute_remote: 0 minutes. The influencer was right about one thing.
offer_commute_office: {office_days} days x {commute_min} min each way = {hours} h a week
offer_signon: Paid as a sign-on bonus. (Big corps love a one-time thing.)

fp_probation.text: Probation: you may be let go for any reason, including 'Q3'.

fp_rto.text: Hybrid policy: work from home on any day that is not a weekday.

fp_unlimited_pto.text: Unlimited PTO*. *Subject to approval, deadlines, and vibes.

fp_non_compete.text: Non-compete: for 24 months you won't work in, near, or think about software.

fp_equity.text: Equity: 0.0001%, 4-year vest, 1-year cliff. Worth one sandwich at target valuation.

fp_ip_clause.text: All ideas you have during employment, including dreams, belong to the Company.

fp_on_call.text: You will join the on-call rotation. The rotation is you.

fp_perks.text: Pizza parties are provided in lieu of raises.

fp_laptop.text: Your laptop ships in 6-8 weeks. Please be productive meanwhile.

fp_salary_review.text: Salary is reviewed annually. Reviewing is not increasing.

fp_runway.text: Your role is secure for the full runway (7 months, give or take a Tuesday).

fp_family.text: The Company reserves the right to call itself 'a family'.
